problem: How can room-temperature plasticity be achieved in brittle intermetallics while retaining high strength?
mechanism_or_method: Framework of amorphous interfaces plus preexisting dislocations enabling deformation-induced crystallization, dislocation emission and storage; micropillar tests and MD.
limitation: Micropillar-scale nanocrystalline samples; scalability to bulk components and tensile ductility unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides microstructure design for ductile high-strength intermetallics.

object: Grade 91 ferritic steel for nuclear components
problem: How can ferritic steel retain ductility after neutron irradiation despite irradiation hardening?
mechanism_or_method: PM-HIP processing yields screw dislocation arrays on which Si-enriched beta-FeSi2 linear complexions form during irradiation, pinning and unpinning dislocation dipoles.
limitation: Single alloy and irradiation condition; long-term in-reactor behavior not verified.
decision_relevance: Favors PM-HIP processing for irradiation-tolerant nuclear structural steels.

problem: How can friction and wear be eliminated in a sliding TENG while raising triboelectrification efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Graphite-SiO2 structural superlubric interface micromachined for atomic-level contact, suppressing air breakdown and giving unipolar charge distribution.
limitation: Micromachined small-area graphite contact; scalability and environmental robustness unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports superlubric interfaces for wear-free energy harvesters.

object: nacre-mimetic composite for passive cooling and impact protection
problem: How can passive radiative cooling and impact resistance be combined in one protective material?
mechanism_or_method: Brick-and-mortar nacre-mimetic composite with dynamic crosslinking giving strain-rate-dependent impact hardening, high solar reflectance and anisotropic thermal conduction.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; outdoor long-term weathering and large-area manufacturing not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs multifunctional enclosure materials for outdoor electronics.

problem: How can the ductility of cast eutectic aluminium alloys be raised without losing strength?
mechanism_or_method: Zr addition forms superlattice nano-layers around eutectic fibres and core-shell nanoparticles that relieve interface stress concentration and promote dislocation networks.
limitation: Specific Al-Gd-Zr composition; cost and castability at industrial scale not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides alloying choices for ductile lightweight cast aluminium.

object: fault gouge under teleseismic wave loading
problem: What triggers earthquakes thousands of kilometers from a mainshock?
mechanism_or_method: Bounding-surface critical-state constitutive model of gouge simulating pore-pressure buildup under teleseismic waves; compressional components amplify pore pressure more than shear.
limitation: Idealized gouge model not validated against in situ fault observations.
decision_relevance: Refines remote-triggering hazard assessment near critically stressed faults.

problem: How can PACT resolution, contrast and depth be improved beyond the aperture-sensitivity trade-off?
mechanism_or_method: High-numerical-aperture focused ultrasonic transducer with phase-inverted focusing-equivalent reconstruction algorithm for 3D imaging.
limitation: Needs custom transducer hardware; validation limited to phantoms and animals.

problem: Should solvent regeneration for ship carbon capture occur onboard or onshore?
mechanism_or_method: Techno-economic comparison of onboard versus onshore regeneration across 16 routes and four solvents, extended to 357 routes with carbon tax scenarios.
limitation: Depends on assumed solvent properties, carbon tax and cost projections to 2050.
decision_relevance: Favors onshore solvent regeneration and ~20% load limits in ship capture design.

problem: Is roadkill burden on threatened species unequally distributed between high-income and low- and middle-income countries?
mechanism_or_method: Standardized comparison of researcher surveys, citizen-science records and a Chinese national dataset controlling for species pools and sampling effort.
limitation: Sampling bias in citizen-science and survey records despite standardization.

problem: What drives spontaneous hole formation in confluent cell monolayers?
mechanism_or_method: Continuum multi-phase field model with internal dissipation and active dipolar forces; substrate friction controls defect-driven spiral flows and stress concentration.
limitation: Continuum model qualitatively compared with MDCK observations without quantitative fitting to new data.

object: polyenamine nanofiltration membranes for lithium extraction
problem: How can membranes achieve higher Li+/Mg2+ selectivity and chemical stability than polyamide?
mechanism_or_method: Click polymerization via amino-yne Michael addition of activated alkynes and amines forming charged, narrow-pore polyenamine selective layers.
limitation: Module-scale tests only; long-term fouling and cost at plant scale not shown.

problem: How can static grip surfaces deliver spatially resolved tactile information to fingertips?
mechanism_or_method: Microtextured skin-coupling interface with phase-controlled vibrotactile actuators generating steerable 3D tactile foci beneath the skin.
limitation: Psychophysical tests with limited participants and tasks; fingertip-specific.
decision_relevance: Guides haptic handle design using phase-controlled actuator arrays.

problem: Does aseismic slip lag or outpace the fluid pressure front during injection?
mechanism_or_method: Laboratory triaxial injection experiments on granite tracking pressure and slip fronts, organized by a dimensionless loading parameter.
limitation: Laboratory-scale saw-cut samples may not capture heterogeneous crustal faults.
decision_relevance: Informs injection-rate limits to avoid fast fault slip in induced seismicity.

object: Salton Sea geothermal brine lithium production
problem: What would large-scale lithium production from Salton Sea brines cost and be competitive?
mechanism_or_method: Techno-economic analysis from company disclosures, patents and brine resource modeling with scenarios of dilution, process route, by-products and capital cost.
limitation: Relies on limited public disclosures and uncertain brine models.

problem: How can print-direction molecular alignment be switched within a single ink for programmable actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Direct ink writing of smectic ink with shear- and temperature-dependent alignment switching from preservation or collapse of smectic layers.
limitation: Single ink chemistry; actuation performance and durability not benchmarked broadly.

object: reactive hydride composites for hydrogen storage
problem: Can complex hydrides release and reabsorb hydrogen reversibly below 400 K?
mechanism_or_method: Tuning LiBH4 content in Mg(NH2)2-LiH reactive hydride composites to lower reaction temperature and alter reaction pathways.
limitation: Capacity only 3.1 wt% and cyclability details limited.

object: graphene on PMN-PT surface acoustic wave device
problem: How can acoustoelectric currents be made large for RF-to-DC conversion and sensing?
mechanism_or_method: SAW delay line on (111) PMN-PT with graphene film in propagation path; introduces acoustoelectric responsivity as figure of merit.
limitation: Single device platform; RF power requirement and efficiency in applications unclear.

object: building cooling energy demand across North America
problem: Do cooling degree days misrepresent cooling demand because they ignore temperature- and humidity-dependent efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Effective cooling degree days metric linking ambient temperature and humidity to thermodynamic work, applied to reanalysis since 1971 and projections.
limitation: Idealized efficiency model not validated against measured building electricity consumption.
decision_relevance: Changes how cooling capacity and demand are forecast under humid versus dry heat.

problem: How can cryogenic alloys reach ~2 GPa yield strength with substantial uniform elongation?
mechanism_or_method: Hierarchical nano-orderings (sigma dispersoids, bimodal L12 precipitates, local chemical order) via additive manufacturing and post-processing triggering sequential dislocation sources.
limitation: Complex multi-step processing; fatigue and fracture toughness at 77 K not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides cryogenic structural alloy processing design for strength and ductility.

problem: Can bound water act as a rate-sensitive crosslinker to create impact-stiffening polymers without specialized motifs?
mechanism_or_method: Confining bound-water networks in proton-rich polymer scaffolds so dissociation kinetics freeze under impact, giving soft-to-rigid transition.
limitation: Humidity sensitivity and long-term stability of water-based crosslinking not detailed.

problem: How can handle sequences be assigned to hundreds of slats to minimize parasitic binding and fabrication burden?
mechanism_or_method: Evolutionary algorithm optimizing handle assignment with an expanded handle library, released as open-source #-CAD software.
limitation: Assembly yields validated only on selected megastructures in the lab.

problem: Can CO2 regeneration be done at mild conditions without bulk thermal stripping?
mechanism_or_method: ZIF-67 dispersed in amine solvent, with microbubble-collapse contact electrocatalysis generating hydroxyl radicals that cleave carbamates.
limitation: Laboratory-scale integrated system; long-term solvent and ZIF stability uncertain.

problem: Can 3D structures show omnidirectional asymmetric topological elasticity at finite frequencies for energy isolation?
mechanism_or_method: Incorporating bending stiffness lifts zero-frequency topological mechanical states to finite-frequency modes localized at one boundary of a 3D lattice.
limitation: Lab-scale prototypes; bandwidth and damping effects for practical vibration shielding unclear.
decision_relevance: Enables directional vibration isolation design with polarized metamaterials.

problem: How can multimodal representations of composites preserve continuous property ordering under data scarcity?
mechanism_or_method: ORDER ordinality-aware image-tabular alignment with physics-based surrogate signals for property prediction, retrieval and microstructure generation.
limitation: Evaluated on two datasets with surrogate property signals, not new physical validation.

object: deuterium fusion in metal hydride foils
problem: Do solid-state environments enhance D-D fusion yield at sub-keV energies?
mechanism_or_method: Dual-chamber platform combining electrochemical deuterium loading of Pd and Ti foils with low-energy ion beam bombardment.
limitation: Extraordinary claim needing independent replication; mechanism not established.

problem: How can handedness be used for wireless control of untethered ultralight flyers?
mechanism_or_method: Natural afterfeathers combined with azobenzene photomechanical actuator giving light-modulated torsion, drag, spinning and altitude; CFD of flow.
limitation: Requires steady airflow and light illumination; payload and outdoor operation not shown.

object: cucurbituril-Matrimid mixed matrix gas separation membranes
problem: Can cavity-shaped sieving channels raise permeability-selectivity beyond upper bounds with aging stability?
mechanism_or_method: Cucurbituril with selective cavity incorporated into Matrimid as short-path gas transport channels improving network connectivity.
limitation: Permeability drops with aging; tested on pure gases rather than industrial mixtures.

object: magnetic nanorobotic swarms in the spinal canal
problem: How can intrathecal therapeutic delivery be navigated spatiotemporally in mice and nonhuman primates?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic nanorobot swarms with chain, vortex and ribbon modes driven by robotic-arm-generated fields; vortex swarm navigates cauda equina.
limitation: Animal studies only; scaling magnetic actuation to human spinal canal unproven.

problem: Can a single membrane switch between CO2-selective and H2-selective separation?
mechanism_or_method: Zr-MOP polymerized hydrogel whose dehydration-induced shrinkage rearranges cages and exposes molecular sieving windows, reversible with pH.
limitation: Switching requires dehydration and stimuli control; durability under real syngas conditions unclear.

problem: How can continuous amorphous mesoporous metal-boron films be synthesized under mild conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Electrodeposition-initiated self-catalyzed electroless growth decoupling nucleation and growth, with finite-element field simulation and theory of OH adsorption.
limitation: Durability tested only in simulated seawater at lab scale.

problem: How can water-cluster structure in nanochannels be regulated to raise water permeance?
mechanism_or_method: Pore-entrance -OH and quaternary N+ groups dissociate (H2O)5H+ clusters into smaller mobile species, shown by in situ liquid ToF-SIMS and MD.
limitation: Mechanism inferred from specialized spectrometry and simulation for one membrane chemistry.

object: ground vibration from blasting demolition of tall buildings
problem: How can blast-induced and collapse-induced vibration waves be separated and their wave-type dominance quantified?
mechanism_or_method: Three-dimensional polarisation-state analysis with normalised dominance factor to separate P, S and Rayleigh components in recorded vibration signals.
limitation: Based on limited demolition events and sensor layouts; site-specific attenuation.
decision_relevance: Refines vibration hazard evaluation and control for nearby structures during demolition.

problem: How can sorption kinetics, cycling stability and solar efficiency of salt-hydrate storage be improved?
mechanism_or_method: Shape-interface-channel ordering: red blood cell-mimic pellets, hydrophilic nanoengineered interfaces and leaf-vein channels with high solar absorptance.
limitation: Pellet-scale tests; reactor-scale performance and long-term stability beyond 1000 cycles unknown.
decision_relevance: Guides pellet geometry design for solar thermochemical storage reactors.

problem: How can transverse mass transport in laminar blood flow be actively enhanced for delivery, thrombolysis and cell enrichment?
mechanism_or_method: Soft cilia on a robot oscillating under tailored magnetic fields to generate flow patterns that move particle collectives toward or away from vessel wall.
limitation: Tested in vascular models and rabbits; human-scale deployment and safety unproven.

problem: Do smectic-A LCEs show auxetic behaviour and anisotropic mechanics via layer frustration?
mechanism_or_method: Acrylate smectic-A LCEs polymerised from nematic precursors; correlation lengths, tensile Poisson ratio, shear rheology and tack measurements confirm de Gennes frustration.
limitation: Auxetic response only above ~40% strain for three formulations.

object: direct air capture based methanol production systems
problem: Can DAC-based methanol production be water-sufficient across arid regions worldwide?
mechanism_or_method: Global techno-economic modeling across 20,000 regions integrating weather-dependent DAC, electrolysis, methanol synthesis and renewables, with air cooling option.
limitation: Model assumptions on DAC performance and renewable supply; no pilot validation.
decision_relevance: Supports siting DAC methanol plants in arid regions with air cooling.

problem: Can suppressing polyamide crystallization boost permeability and selectivity in scalable interfacial polymerization?
mechanism_or_method: Ultra-low-temperature (-20 C) interfacial polymerization forming smooth, defect-free amorphous selective layer; life-cycle assessment on real wastewater.
limitation: Cooling cost at manufacturing scale and long-term membrane stability not fully addressed.

problem: Why does sulfate grow rapidly in polluted air, and do brake wear particles convert SO2 to sulfate?
mechanism_or_method: Laboratory uptake measurements showing alpha-Fe2O3 oxygen vacancies and carbonaceous components sustain cyclic catalytic SO2 oxidation in the dark.
limitation: Laboratory particles and conditions; contribution to ambient sulfate not quantified.

problem: How can small, low-power, multifunctional biomimetic soft actuators with high electromechanical output be built?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer dots in PVDF terpolymer with interfacial hydrogen bonding and temperature modulation forming gradient polarized regions in a monolayer.
limitation: High driving field (100 MV/m) and 50 mg demonstrators; durability and payload limited.

problem: How can TPMS sheet and strut lattices be connected to give compatible geometry and graded mechanical properties?
mechanism_or_method: Twinned unit-cell transition substructures with tunable modulus enabling direct generation of 3D-printable files for hybrid lattices.
limitation: Static stiffness prototypes; fatigue and fabrication defects at joints not examined.
decision_relevance: Enables graded-stiffness lattice design for implants and interfaces.

problem: Can a soft robot achieve multimodal 3D swimming with only two pneumatic inputs?
mechanism_or_method: Monostable instability in flexible arms converts two actuation inputs into pulsation, fish-like propulsion and rotor-like reorientation; PIV and CFD analysis.
limitation: Tethered pneumatic supply and tank tests; cost of transport remains high.
decision_relevance: Shows mechanical intelligence can cut actuator count in soft swimmers.

problem: What is the microscopic nature of the electrolyte-to-metal transition in lithium-ammonia solutions?
mechanism_or_method: Ab initio molecular dynamics with many-body perturbation theory, validated against photoelectron spectroscopy, revealing femtosecond band-gap flipping.
limitation: Small simulation cells and finite timescales; comparison relies on prior experiments.

object: critical metal requirements in automotive electrification
problem: Addendum clarifying conceptual ambiguity in the critical-metal requirement results.
mechanism_or_method: Textual clarification of the original results section; no new method presented.
limitation: Abstract gives no substantive content beyond a clarification.

object: nondeterministic architected materials from swarm agents
problem: Can decentralized simulated agents generate architected structures with predictable rule-structure-property relationships?
mechanism_or_method: Simulated swarm agents acting on local information build structures; 3D printing and finite element analysis characterize tensile strength and energy dissipation.
limitation: Stochastic outputs limit control; tested on limited rule sets and print materials.

problem: How can productivity of operando-electrified NaHCO3 synthesis be raised toward the traditional Solvay process?
mechanism_or_method: Eight-electron nitrogen chemistry to generate local alkalinity plus liquid metal-derived catalyst breaking scaling relationships.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer scale; energy cost and stability versus conventional process not shown.

problem: How can iterative reconstruction for sparse-sensor 3D photoacoustic imaging avoid prohibitive memory and time?
mechanism_or_method: Point-cloud model of Gaussian spherical sources optimized and adaptively split, duplicated or destroyed along gradients (SlingBAG).
limitation: In vivo validation required animal imaging hardware; generalization to other sensor geometries unclear.

object: microstructure diffusion-based plastic deformation in alloys
problem: How can local diffusivity and deformation be mapped across microstructures at high resolution and throughput?
mechanism_or_method: Local deformation mapping: pressing a nanomold onto microstructure to extrude nanorods whose length and composition give diffusivity maps via analytical model.
limitation: Requires nanomold fabrication; indirect diffusivity inference through an analytical model.

object: capacitive rotor for alternating current generation
problem: Addendum describing a rotor with coherent capacitance variation generating alternating current from rotation.
mechanism_or_method: Rotor of repeating capacitive units varying capacitance between maximum and minimum at fixed voltage to drive alternating current.
limitation: Theoretical proposal only; no experimental demonstration in abstract.

problem: How can mechanical, morphometric and mass-transport properties of meta-biomaterials be decoupled?
mechanism_or_method: Geometric bounds plus high-throughput numerical homogenization (44,837 simulations) and multi-objective optimization, validated on PolyJet and two-photon printed samples.
limitation: Only Poisson ratio and density fully decoupled; deviations up to ~14% and no cell studies.
decision_relevance: Enables independent tuning of scaffold properties in lattice design.

object: iron meteorite under high-energy proton irradiation
problem: How do asteroid materials respond mechanically to rapid irradiation heating relevant to deflection?
mechanism_or_method: 440 GeV proton beam at CERN HiRadMat on a Campo del Cielo meteorite sample with laser Doppler vibrometry recording stress waves.
limitation: Single iron meteorite sample; other asteroid compositions and scales not tested.
decision_relevance: Informs strength assumptions in asteroid deflection modelling.

object: model glass formers under oscillatory shear
problem: How does glass fragility control the yielding transition and its dependence on annealing?
mechanism_or_method: Extensive molecular simulations of strong and fragile glass formers rationalized by a new elastoplastic model.
limitation: Model glasses and qualitative elastoplastic agreement, not validated on real metallic glasses.

object: Emeishan Large Igneous Province methane emissions
problem: Were methane emissions from oil thermal cracking in the ELIP large enough to drive end-Guadalupian warming and extinction?
mechanism_or_method: Critical reassessment of earlier gas generation estimates, questioning key assumptions and arguing emissions were much smaller.
limitation: Rebuttal-style reassessment; alternative drivers not identified or quantified.

object: amorphous polymer films for organic molecule separation
problem: Can amorphous polymers without structured pores separate small organic solutes with high selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer film balancing hydrophobicity, hydrophilicity and chain mobility to form optimal pores with reversibly switchable opposite selectivities.
limitation: Tested on selected solute mixtures; long-term stability and flux at scale unclear.

problem: Can reaction-diffusion morphogenesis grow structures with target orthotropic stiffness tensors without topology optimization?
mechanism_or_method: Anisotropic Turing reaction-diffusion generative model with database linking morphogenetic parameters to homogenized elastic tensors; mechanical cloaking demonstration.
limitation: Elastic tensors limited to orthotropic targets; cloaking validated on a simple defect example.
decision_relevance: Offers cheaper alternative to topology optimization for anisotropic stiffness design.

object: Stirling engine driven by radiative cooling
problem: Can Earth's ambient radiation be converted to mechanical power using a Stirling engine?
mechanism_or_method: Radiative-cooling-sustained temperature difference over >10 C drives a Stirling engine; outdoor year-round experiments and air circulation application.
limitation: Low power density (~0.4 W/m2 measured) and dependence on sky conditions.
decision_relevance: Supports passive engine-driven ventilation for greenhouses and buildings.

object: pristine carbon fiber bipolar electrochemical actuator
problem: Can untreated carbon fibers be actuated by bipolar electrochemistry as microtweezers?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric redox at surface grooves in a closed bipolar cell causes ion intercalation and reversible fiber bending; two fibers form tweezers.
limitation: Requires electrolyte bath and threshold potentials; force and speed not benchmarked.

problem: How can non-volatile mechanical memory and wave-based perception be unified for in-memory learning?
mechanism_or_method: Structural states program elastic-wave responses; offline-optimized input waveforms combine localization-mode features to classify patterns from output energy.
limitation: Small-scale tasks such as shapes and digits; scaling to complex tasks uncertain.

problem: Can a nanolayer overcoating improve acid resistance and surface mechanics of dental glass-ceramics?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic layer deposition of hybrid TiO2/Al2O3 nanolayer with TiO2 providing acid resistance and Al2O3 improving interfacial bonding.
limitation: In vitro acid and cytotoxicity tests only; clinical wear durability unproven.

problem: Can optimal asymptotic work be extracted from unknown quantum states without knowing their description?
mechanism_or_method: Construction of an input-state-independent quantum channel whose extracted work equals the free energy of the unknown i.i.d. input state.
limitation: Asymptotic i.i.d. setting; infinite-dimensional case only partially covered.

object: machine learning interatomic potentials free energy
problem: How can vibrational free energy be estimated efficiently and differentiably across potential parameters at meV/atom accuracy?
mechanism_or_method: Free energy as Legendre transform of a descriptor entropy estimated by score matching, with tensor compression, enabling back-propagation to phase boundaries.
limitation: Demonstrated on model potentials such as Fe; scaling to complex multi-phase systems untested.
